title: haq fasaana mere hussain ka hai
body:
haq fasaana mere hussain ka hai
sab ne maana mere hussain ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
haq nibhaana mere hussain ka hai
dil thikaana mere hussain ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
har zamana mere hussain ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jis jagah hur banaaye jaate hai
kaarqaana mere hussain ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jiski qaatir ye kaaenaath bani
wo to naana mere hussain ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jo zamee'n se anaj ugta hai
daana daana mere hussain ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
jisko kehte hai baghe jannat wo
aastaana mere hussain ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bas wahi ek shaks hai hoshiyaar
jo diwana mere hussain ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hashr ki dhop me shifaa'at ka
shaamiyaana mere hussain ka hai
<<DIVIDER>>
tool sajdo ko de rahe hai nabi
martaba kya mere hussain ka hai
